list.title: Chats

empty.active: No chats yet. Start one from the agents above.

list.deleteConfirmBody: “{title}” and its messages move to the trash, where they stay restorable.

empty.noAgentsDescription: This place has no agent a chat can be started with yet. Add one, or give an existing one access to this project.

messages.noteSaved: Chat saved as a note in Docs.
messages.noteSaveFailed: Could not save the chat as a note.
messages.restoreFailedTitle: This chat could not be loaded
messages.restoreFailed: Its messages could not be read. Check the connection and try again.

composer.hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter for a new line · Esc stops the answer · ↑ edits your last message · drop or paste files to attach · / for commands and prompts
composer.commandNotAvailable: This command isn’t available from the chat yet.
composer.concurrencyLimit: {agent} is already answering {limit} chats. Wait for one to finish, or open it in the chat list.
composer.modelNotFound: No model matches “{query}”. Type /model to see the available ones.
composer.reasoningNeedsModel: Pick a model first with /model — “Agent default” has no reasoning levels of its own to choose from.
composer.usage: This chat has used {tokens, number} tokens so far, the context size after its last answer.
composer.usageNone: No answer yet to measure token usage from.
composer.undoDone: Removed the last exchange. Send a new message to continue from before it.

refusal.schedules: Hermes’ own scheduling commands aren’t run from chat — use Helena’s routines instead.
refusal.approvals: Approval commands aren’t run from chat — use the approval card or the Approvals page.
refusal.config: This changes the agent’s own configuration — use the agent’s settings in Helena instead.
refusal.outside: This isn’t something the chat can do.

composer.dictationBlocked: The browser did not allow the microphone. Allow it in the site settings.
composer.dictationInsecure: Browsers only lend the microphone to HTTPS pages. Until Helena runs on HTTPS: open chrome://flags in Chrome, enable “Insecure origins treated as secure” and add {origin}. The kiosk already allows it.
composer.autoSpeakOn: Answers are read aloud – click to turn off

issue.createdBody: The task is linked back to this chat, and the chat is linked to it.

approval.title: Approval
approval.approvedToast: Approved. The agent gets a new run with your decision.
approval.rejectedToast: Rejected. The agent gets a new run with your decision.

status.template: Template — add it to a project to chat with it

agents.switch: Chatting with {agent} — start a new chat with another agent

interrupted.lost: The connection to the answer was lost. {agent} may still be working on it.
interrupted.failed: The answer broke off before it was finished.
interrupted.sendFailed: The message could not be sent.
interrupted.continuePrompt: Please continue where you were interrupted.

activity.queued: Waiting for {agent} — its runner is offline. The answer starts once it is back.
